mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_execution_task WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT ec.*, fc.num AS case_num, fc.name AS case_name FROM ai_execution_case ec LEFT JOIN functional_case fc ON fc.id = ec.case_id WHERE ec.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY ec.pos ASC, ec.create_time ASC
SELECT * FROM ai_runner WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM ai_runner_lease WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM ai_execution_artifact WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM ai_execution_artifact WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND sha256 = #{sha256} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND ((step_id IS NULL AND #{stepId} IS NULL) OR step_id = #{stepId}) LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_execution_artifact WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_runner r WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND r.status = 'ONLINE' AND r.last_heartbeat_time >= #{runnerStaleBefore}) AS onlineRunnerCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_runner r WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND (r.status != 'ONLINE' OR r.last_heartbeat_time IS NULL OR r.last_heartbeat_time < #{runnerStaleBefore})) AS staleRunnerCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_runner_lease l JOIN ai_runner r ON r.id = l.runner_id WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND l.status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.expire_time >= #{now}) AS activeLeaseCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_execution_task t WHERE t.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND t.status = 'QUEUED') AS queuedTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_execution_task t WHERE t.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND t.status IN ('PREPARING_BROWSER','WAITING_LOGIN','RUNNING','PAUSED','WRITING_BACK') AND t.update_time < #{taskStuckBefore}) AS stuckTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_execution_task t WHERE t.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND (t.status = 'WRITING_BACK' OR t.writeback_status IN ('FAILED','PARTIAL'))) AS writebackBacklogCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_execution_task t WHERE t.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND t.status IN ('SUCCESS','PARTIAL_SUCCESS','FAILED') AND t.artifact_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED','PARTIAL')) AS artifactBacklogCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_execution_artifact a JOIN ai_execution_task t ON t.id = a.task_id WHERE t.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND a.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND a.retention_until IS NOT NULL AND a.retention_until <= #{now}) AS expiredArtifactCount
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_runner_lease WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_time >= #{now}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_execution_artifact WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE'

SELECT * FROM ai_execution_task WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND (runner_id IS NULL OR runner_id = '' OR runner_id = #{runnerId}) ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) FROM ai_execution_event WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_execution_task ( id, organization_id, project_id, test_plan_id, source, selection_mode, prompt, resolved_filter, case_snapshot_hash, policy_snapshot, status, runner_id, runner_lease_id, provider_id, environment_id, target_url, browser_type, login_mode, idempotency_key, confirm_required, confirmation_reason, total_count, success_count, failed_count, blocked_count, skipped_count, unexecuted_count, writeback_status, artifact_status, executed_by, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{projectId}, #{testPlanId}, #{source}, #{selectionMode}, #{prompt}, #{resolvedFilter}, #{caseSnapshotHash}, #{policySnapshot}, #{status}, #{runnerId}, #{runnerLeaseId}, #{providerId}, #{environmentId}, #{targetUrl}, #{browserType}, #{loginMode}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{confirmRequired}, #{confirmationReason}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{blockedCount}, #{skippedCount}, #{unexecutedCount}, #{writebackStatus}, #{artifactStatus}, #{executedBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0) )

INSERT INTO ai_execution_case ( id, task_id, project_id, case_id, test_plan_id, test_plan_case_id, case_version, case_snapshot, status, result, pos, retry_count, heal_count, healed, error_message, failure_category, writeback_status, create_time, update_time, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{taskId}, #{projectId}, #{caseId}, #{testPlanId}, #{testPlanCaseId}, #{caseVersion}, #{caseSnapshot}, #{status}, #{result}, #{pos}, #{retryCount}, COALESCE(#{healCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{healed}, 0), #{errorMessage}, #{failureCategory}, #{writebackStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0) )

INSERT INTO ai_execution_step ( id, task_id, execution_case_id, case_id, source_step_id, pos, instruction, expected, action_json, assertion_json, risk_level, retryable, status, actual_result, error_message, failure_category, attempt, retry_count, healed, started_at, finished_at, create_time, update_time, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{taskId}, #{executionCaseId}, #{caseId}, #{sourceStepId}, #{pos}, #{instruction}, #{expected}, #{actionJson}, #{assertionJson}, #{riskLevel}, #{retryable}, #{status}, #{actualResult}, #{errorMessage}, #{failureCategory}, #{attempt}, #{retryCount}, #{healed}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0) )

INSERT INTO ai_runner_lease ( id, task_id, runner_id, status, lease_token_hash, accepted_time, expire_time, last_heartbeat_time, last_event_sequence, create_time, update_time, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{taskId}, #{runnerId}, #{status}, #{leaseTokenHash}, #{acceptedTime}, #{expireTime}, #{lastHeartbeatTime}, #{lastEventSequence}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0) )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_execution_healing SET result = #{result}, after_artifact_id = #{afterArtifactId}, duration_ms = GREATEST(0, #{eventTime} - create_time) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND execution_step_id = #{stepId} AND attempt = #{attempt} AND result = 'STARTED'

UPDATE ai_runner_lease SET expire_time = #{expireTime}, last_heartbeat_time = #{heartbeatTime}, update_time = #{heartbeatTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND runner_id = #{runnerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE ai_runner_lease SET last_event_sequence = #{lastEventSequence}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND runner_id = #{runnerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND last_event_sequence = #{previousEventSequence}
UPDATE ai_runner_lease SET status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND runner_id = #{runnerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE ai_execution_task SET status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND runner_lease_id = #{leaseId} AND status IN ('PREPARING_BROWSER', 'WAITING_LOGIN', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED')

UPDATE ai_execution_step SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt = #{attempt}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{updateTime}), update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND id = #{stepId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE ai_execution_step SET status = 'HEALING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND id = #{stepId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE ai_execution_step SET status = 'RUNNING', healed = 1, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND id = #{stepId} AND status = 'HEALING'

UPDATE ai_execution_step SET status = #{status}, actual_result = #{actualResult}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, failure_category = #{failureCategory}, healed = CASE WHEN #{healed} THEN 1 ELSE healed END, finished_at = #{updateTime}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND id = #{stepId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'BLOCKED', 'SKIPPED', 'NEEDS_REVIEW', 'ERROR')
UPDATE ai_execution_case SET status = 'RUNNING', update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND case_id = #{caseId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CREATED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE ai_execution_case SET status = #{status}, result = #{result}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND case_id = #{caseId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'BLOCKED', 'SKIPPED', 'NEEDS_REVIEW', 'ERROR')

UPDATE ai_execution_case SET writeback_status = #{writebackStatus}, error_message = COALESCE(#{errorMessage}, error_message), update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND case_id = #{caseId}

UPDATE ai_execution_task SET status = #{status}, success_count = #{successCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, blocked_count = #{blockedCount}, skipped_count = #{skippedCount}, unexecuted_count = #{unexecutedCount}, writeback_status = #{writebackStatus}, artifact_status = #{artifactStatus}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'WRITING_BACK'

UPDATE ai_execution_task SET status = #{status}, success_count = #{successCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, blocked_count = #{blockedCount}, skipped_count = #{skippedCount}, unexecuted_count = #{unexecutedCount}, version = version + 1, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_execution_case SET status = 'PENDING', result = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = NULL, failure_category = NULL, writeback_status = 'PENDING', version = version + 1, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'BLOCKED')

UPDATE ai_execution_step SET status = 'PENDING', actual_result = NULL, error_message = NULL, failure_category = NULL, attempt = attempt + 1, healed = 0, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND execution_case_id IN ( SELECT id FROM ai_execution_case WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'BLOCKED') )

UPDATE ai_execution_task SET status = 'QUEUED', runner_id = NULL, runner_lease_id = NULL, success_count = #{successCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, blocked_count = #{blockedCount}, skipped_count = #{skippedCount}, unexecuted_count = #{unexecutedCount}, writeback_status = 'PENDING', artifact_status = 'PENDING', update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM test_plan tp

SELECT tp.id, tp.name, tp.project_id AS projectId, tp.status, tp.num, COALESCE(fc.case_count, 0) AS associatedCaseCount FROM test_plan tp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT test_plan_id, COUNT(1) AS case_count FROM test_plan_functional_case GROUP BY test_plan_id ) fc ON fc.test_plan_id = tp.id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN tp.status IN ('UNDERWAY', 'RUNNING', 'IN_PROGRESS') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, tp.update_time DESC, tp.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

sql.where:
fc.project_id = #{projectId} AND fc.deleted = 0 AND fc.latest = 1
AND ( LOWER(fc.id) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR LOWER(fc.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR CAST(fc.num AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM functional_case fc

SELECT NULL AS id, NULL AS task_id, fc.project_id, fc.id AS case_id, fc.num AS case_num, fc.name AS case_name, NULL AS test_plan_id, NULL AS test_plan_case_id, NULL AS status, fc.last_execute_result AS result, 0 AS pos, 0 AS retry_count, NULL AS error_message, fc.create_time, fc.update_time FROM functional_case fc
ORDER BY fc.pos ASC, fc.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT fc.id FROM functional_case fc WHERE fc.project_id = #{projectId} AND fc.deleted = 0 AND fc.latest = 1 ORDER BY fc.pos ASC, fc.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_runner_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (lease_expire_time IS NULL OR lease_expire_time > #{now})
AND (domain = #{domain} OR domain LIKE CONCAT('%.', #{domain}) OR #{domain} LIKE CONCAT('%.', domain))
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_execution_event WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND event_type IN ('EVIDENCE_ATTACHED', 'ARTIFACT_ATTACHED', 'SCREENSHOT', 'VIDEO', 'HAR')
